Existing shared builders provide the chairs, sofa and glass table. The planter uses a cabinet shell plus four raised foliage objects, and the screen uses a grooved wall-panel. Actual bucket-chair curves, wood chair legs, table lower shelf, white planter stones and fine screen ribs are simplified.
